effect.name: GM Radial Velocity
effect.desc: Center-origin velocity blur with normalized weighted sampling.
effect.shader: void main(){vec2 u=acScreenNorm;vec2 screenSize=max(acScreenSize,vec2(1.0));vec2 c=(acLayerCenter+center)/screenSize;vec2 d=u-c;float a=strength*pow(max(length(d)*1.4142,0.00001),max(falloff,0.00001));vec4 sum=vec4(0.0);float wsum=0.0;for(int i=0;i<12;i++){float t=float(i)/11.0;float w=1.0-abs(t-0.5);sum+=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(u-d*a*t,0.0,1.0))*w;wsum+=w;}gl_FragColor=sum/max(wsum,0.0001);}
